title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
楚皓头痛欲裂。陌生的记忆如同潮水般涌入脑海。他穿越了。成了大炎王朝，青阳城楚家一个同名同姓的废物少爷。这身体的原主，资质平庸，修炼数年仍在淬体境三重徘徊。典型的纨绔子弟，除了吃喝玩乐，一无是处。然而，就是这样一个废物，却有一门令人艳羡的婚约。未婚妻是来自皇都的顶尖世家，萧家嫡女，萧清雪。萧清雪天资绝世，容颜倾城，年仅十六岁便已是凝气境巅峰，被誉为大炎王朝百年难遇的明珠。据闻，她已被某个神秘的超级宗门看中，未来成就不可限量。今日，便是楚家与萧家约定，正式举行订婚大典的日子。萧家之人，包括萧清雪本人，昨日便已抵达青阳城楚府。楚皓消化完记忆，只觉一阵荒谬。废物配天骄？这剧本不对。“原主是走了什么狗屎运？”楚皓自语。他挣扎着从床上坐起。铜镜映出一张还算清秀，但带着几分病态苍白的脸。这便是他如今的模样。“既来之，则安之吧。”楚皓叹息。就在此时，一道冰冷的机械音在他脑海中响起。【叮！检测到宿主灵魂归位，神级选择系统正式激活！】楚皓一怔。系统？穿越者的标配福利终于到账了？【新手任务发布：退婚！】【选项一：在订婚大典上，当众向萧清雪表达爱意，巩固婚约。任务奖励：黄级下品功法一部，淬体丹十颗。】【选项二：在订婚大典上，当众羞辱未婚妻萧清雪，撕毁婚约，并大声宣告：“三十年河东，三十年河西，莫欺少年穷！但你，萧清雪，今日还配不上我楚皓！”任务奖励：混沌圣体！神级功法《吞天魔功》！】【请宿主在十分钟内做出选择，倒计时开始：9:59…9:58…】楚皓瞪大眼睛。选项一的奖励，简直是打发乞丐。黄级下品功法？淬体丹？对于如今的楚家少爷身份，或许还有点用。但对于一个拥有系统的穿越者，这根本不值一提。再看选项二。

混沌圣体！神级功法《吞天魔功》！楚皓虽然刚穿越，但也从记忆中知晓这个世界的修炼体系。体质，对修者而言至关重要。圣体，那已是传说中的存在，亿万中无一。混沌圣体，更是圣体中的皇者，听名字就霸道绝伦。神级功法，顾名思义，神灵修炼的法门，其威力可想而知。这两个奖励，任何一个都足以让整个玄黄大陆为之疯狂。然而，任务要求却让他头皮发麻。当众羞辱萧清雪？撕毁婚约？还要喊出那句中二且拉仇恨的台词？萧清雪是谁？未来的女帝啊！这记忆里虽然没有明确说她会成女帝，但那超级宗门亲传弟子，未来成就至少也是一方巨擘。得罪了她，恐怕整个楚家都得跟着陪葬。楚皓额头渗出冷汗。这系统，是要把他往死里坑啊！“这选项二，分明是送死任务！”他咬牙。可是，混沌圣体和《吞天魔功》的诱惑实在太大了。若能得到这两样东西，他的人生将彻底改变。什么废物少爷，什么资质平庸，都将成为过去。他将一步登天，拥有无限可能。【倒计时：5:30…5:29…】冰冷的声音催促着。楚皓内心天人交战。选一，苟活一时，但未来黯淡无光，甚至可能因为萧清雪的崛起而被萧家瞧不上，最终还是难逃被退婚的命运，沦为笑柄。选二，九死一生，但若成功，便是海阔凭鱼跃，天高任鸟飞。“妈的，搏了！”楚皓眼中闪过一抹疯狂。前世碌碌无为，这一世拥有系统，难道还要继续平庸下去？富贵险中求！“我选择选项二！”楚皓在心中怒吼。【叮！宿主选择完毕。请宿主尽快完成任务，领取奖励。】系统声音落下。楚皓深吸一口气。他知道，从他做出选择的这一刻起，平静的生活将彻底离他远去。等待他的，将是无尽的波澜与凶险。
content_en:
Chu Hao had a splitting headache.Strange memories flooded into my mind like a tide.He traveled through time.He became a good-for-nothing young master with the same name from the Chu family in Qingyang City during the Great Yan Dynasty.The original owner of this body had mediocre qualifications and was still wandering at the third level of the body tempering realm after practicing for several years.A typical playboy who has nothing to offer except eating, drinking and having fun.However, such a waste has an enviable marriage contract.His fiancée is Xiao Qingxue, the legitimate daughter of the Xiao family, who comes from a top family in the imperial capital.Xiao Qingxue was extremely talented and beautiful. At the age of only sixteen, she was already at the peak of the Qi Condensation Realm. She was known as the once-in-a-century pearl of the Great Yan Dynasty.It is said that she has been spotted by a mysterious super sect and her future achievements are limitless.Today is the day that the Chu family and the Xiao family agreed to officially hold the engagement ceremony.People from the Xiao family, including Xiao Qingxue himself, arrived at the Chu Mansion in Qingyang City yesterday.After Chu Hao digested the memory, he felt ridiculous.A trash match for a genius?This script is wrong."What kind of bad luck did the original owner have?" Chu Hao said to himself.He struggled to sit up from the bed.The bronze mirror reflected a pretty, but somewhat sickly pale face.This is what he looks like now."Now that it's here, let's make peace with it." Chu Hao sighed.At this moment, a cold mechanical sound sounded in his mind.【bite!The return of the host soul is detected, and the god-level selection system is officially activated!】Chu Hao was startled.system?Have the standard benefits for time travelers finally arrived?[Newbie mission release: break off the engagement!】【Option 1: At the engagement ceremony, express your love to Xiao Qingxue in public and consolidate the engagement.Mission reward: a yellow-level low-grade skill and ten body-tempering pills.】[Option 2: At the engagement ceremony, humiliate your fiancée Xiao Qingxue in public, tear up the engagement, and declare loudly: "Thirty years in Hedong, thirty years in Hexi, don't bully young people into poverty! But you, Xiao Qingxue, are not worthy of me, Chu Hao, today!" Mission reward: Chaos Holy Body!The god-level skill "Swallowing the Sky Demon Skill"!】【Ask the host to make a choice within ten minutes, the countdown begins: 9:59...9:58...】Chu Hao's eyes widened.The reward for option one is simply a beggar’s farewell.A low-grade Huang-level skill?Body Tempering Pill?It may be of some use to the current young master of the Chu family.But for a time traveler with a system, this is not worth mentioning at all.Let’s look at option two.

Chaos Holy Body!The god-level skill "Swallowing the Sky Demon Skill"!Although Chu Hao had just traveled through time, he still knew the cultivation system of this world from his memory.Physical fitness is very important to practitioners.The Holy Body is already a legendary existence, unique among billions.The Chaos Holy Body is the emperor among the holy bodies, and the name sounds domineering.God-level exercises, as the name suggests, are methods of spiritual cultivation, and its power can be imagined.Either of these two rewards is enough to make the entire Xuanhuang Continent go crazy.However, the demands of the mission made his scalp tingle.Humiliate Xiao Qingxue in public?Break up the engagement?Do you still want to shout out that line that is both middle-grade and annoying?Who is Xiao Qingxue?The future empress!Although this memory does not clearly say that she will become the empress, the super sect's direct disciple will at least become a giant in the future.If she offends her, I'm afraid the entire Chu family will be buried with her.Cold sweat broke out on Chu Hao's forehead.This system is going to trap him to death!"This option two is clearly a death mission!" He gritted his teeth.However, the temptation of the Chaos Holy Body and the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" is too great.If he could get these two things, his life would completely change.The good-for-nothing young master and mediocre qualifications will all become a thing of the past.He will reach the sky in one step and have unlimited possibilities.[Countdown: 5:30…5:29…] A cold voice urged.Chu Hao's heart was filled with conflict between heaven and man.Choose one and survive for a while, but the future will be bleak. You may even be looked down upon by the Xiao family because of Xiao Qingxue's rise. In the end, you will still be unable to escape the fate of being broken off and become a laughing stock.Choose two and have a narrow escape from death, but if you succeed, the sea will be vast for fish to leap, and the sky will be high for birds to fly."Damn, let's fight!" A flash of madness flashed in Chu Hao's eyes.I was mediocre in my previous life, but I have a system in this life. Will I continue to be mediocre?Find wealth in danger!"I choose option two!" Chu Hao roared in his heart.【bite!Host selection is completed.The host is asked to complete the task as soon as possible and receive the reward.】The system sound falls.Chu Hao took a deep breath.He knew that from the moment he made his choice, his peaceful life would completely leave him.What awaits him will be endless waves and dangers.
